apod.title: Put on your red/blue glasses and gaze across the western Ocean of Storms on the surface of the Moon
apod.explanation: Put on your red/blue glasses and gaze across the western Ocean of Storms on the surface of the Moon. The 3D anaglyph shows Apollo 12 astronaut Pete Conrad visiting the Surveyor 3 spacecraft in November of 1969.
